description: Source code for pucch_power_controller class managing PUCCH power control, SINR updates, and TPC commands in a 3GPP-compliant wireless system.

classes.name: pucch_power_controller
classes.description: Manages PUCCH power control, SINR updates, and TPC command generation for different PUCCH formats.

methods.name: reconfigure
methods.description: Reconfigures PUCCH resource formats and power control settings based on UE configuration.

methods.name: get_tpc
methods.description: Calculates the Transmit Power Control (TPC) command based on SINR difference.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f0_f1
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH formats 0 and 1, adjusting for delta TF.

methods.name: update_pucch_sinr_f2_f3_f4
methods.description: Updates SINR measurements for PUCCH formats 2, 3, and 4, adjusting for delta TF.

methods.name: update_pucch_pw_ctrl_state
methods.description: Stores PUCCH power control data and computes delta TF for a given slot.

methods.name: compute_tpc_command
methods.description: Computes the TPC command for a given PUCCH slot based on SINR targets and current power control state.
